description: Draft a project proposal when a freelancer wants to quote a client request or prepare a scope of work. Send a short brief with client, scope, timeline, and budget, not the full chat history. An explicit price is used as the total; otherwise code calculates estimated hours times the user's rate. Returns an editor link for review. Does not publish, send, collect payment, or create change orders. Every account includes one free personal draft. Further AI drafts use generation limits, not publication credits. Publishing an approval link uses one credit in the web app. Optional Pro includes zero publication credits.

deal_description.description: Brief description of the client's request. Do not send the full chat history.

language.description: Language of the proposal. If omitted, it follows the language of the description.
